title: Draftsperson
abstract: Join a growing residential builder as a Draftsperson—flexible work, great team, and strong project pipeline in Melbourne.
screening_questions: Have you completed a qualification in building design / building design drafting?
Have you completed a qualification in engineering drafting / engineering design?
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
Have you worked in a role which requires a sound understanding of the Building Code of Australia (BCA)?
Which of the following Microsoft Office products are you experienced with?
Which of the following CAD software do you have experience with?
content_text:
We are a contemporary residential home builder and property developer based in Port Melbourne, known for delivering high-quality, medium-density multi-unit projects across Melbourne. With a strong pipeline of work and a reputation for excellence, we’re continuing to grow and are looking for passionate individuals to join our team.
About the Role
We have an exciting opportunity for a detail-oriented Draftsperson to join our dynamic and fast-paced environment. Reporting directly to the Drafting Manager, you'll work collaboratively with a team of skilled professionals, with the flexibility to work from both our Port Melbourne office and remotely.
Key Responsibilities
Your key duties will include, but are not limited to:
- Producing accurate working drawings using AutoCAD, including siting plans, floor plans, elevations, internal layouts, electrical plans, and façade details.
- Ensuring all drawings comply with Building Codes, Council, and Developer requirements.
- Reviewing site levels and designing site works.
- Interpreting and incorporating structural engineering and energy efficiency requirements.
- Liaising with internal teams, consultants, suppliers, and planning authorities.
- Assisting with town planning documentation and Council submissions.
- Providing support on production and construction-related queries.
About You
We’re looking for someone with:
- A formal qualification in drafting (Diploma or higher).
- Experience in a similar drafting role, ideally within residential construction.
- Proficiency in AutoCAD and the ability to read and produce detailed working drawings.
- A solid understanding of the Building Regulations, Small Lot Housing Code, and NCC requirements.
- Strong analytical skills and Microsoft Office proficiency.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- A proactive, detail-oriented mindset and a strong work ethic.
- A collaborative and positive approach to teamwork.
Why Join Us?
- Flexible working arrangements, including remote options.
- Onsite staff parking.
- Supportive, experienced leadership in drafting and design.
- Opportunities to grow within a successful and expanding business.
